left.title: Why Susan Collins claims she’s being bribed over her Kavanaugh vote
left.body: A Crowdpac crowdfunding campaign to encourage Collins to vote against Kavanaugh has the senator and others sounding the alarm.
left.roundup: A crowdfunding website is threatening Senator Susan Collins (R-ME) by pledging to donate at least $1.1 million to her opponent if she votes for Brett Kavanaugh.

center.title: 'Vulgar' calls, threats and 'bribery': Kavanaugh pressure mounts for Sen. Collins
center.body: Emotions are high as Brett Kavanaugh's Supreme Court confirmation vote approaches, and Maine Republican Sen. Susan Collins has found herself at the center of a fevered effort to block President Donald Trump's second nominee to the high court.
center.roundup: A crowdfunding website is threatening Senator Susan Collins (R-ME) by pledging to donate at least $1.1 million to her opponent if she votes for Brett Kavanaugh.

right.title: OPINION: You Can’t Bribe Susan Collins
right.body: A crowdfunding campaign threatens the Senator on Kavanaugh.
right.roundup: A crowdfunding website is threatening Senator Susan Collins (R-ME) by pledging to donate at least $1.1 million to her opponent if she votes for Brett Kavanaugh.
